# MediaPipe (vendored)

`vision_bundle.mjs`, `wasm/` and `selfie_segmenter.tflite` come unchanged from Google's MediaPipe
(`@mediapipe/tasks-vision` npm package and the MediaPipe selfie segmenter model), licensed under the
Apache License 2.0 (same text as this repository's `LICENSE`). Copyright The MediaPipe Authors.
They are kept here so the app loads nothing from third-party servers.
